en.topic_title: Explosions, red flags: Chinese tourists reenact communist victory
en.topic_summary:
Dressed in Red Army uniforms and waving prop weapons, scores of tourists stormed a mound in southwestern China’s Loushan Pass as pyrotechnics lit up the hillside in a reenactment of a historic battle.



This photo taken on July 25, 2026 shows performers and tourists taking part in a reenactment of a battle between Chinese Communist and Nationalist forces, at Loushan Pass in Zunyi, in southwestern China’s Guizhou Province. Photo: Jade Gao/AFP.



More than 1,000 people visited the mo
